headlines.title: Attorney General Todd Blanche says the DOJ may take states’ voter-roll fight to Supreme Court
headlines.description: In an interview with Meet the Press, Attorney General Todd Blanche says "absolutely it's a possibility" that the Department of Justice may take the Trump administration's fight over voter rolls to the Supreme Court.

headlines.title: Hawaii braces for impact from Lala
headlines.description: Hawaii’s Big Island was seeing heavy rain and strong winds on Saturday as Lala gained strength, with conditions expected to deteriorate in the hours ahead. NBC News’ Morgan Chesky reports.

headlines.title: Five shot in Lexington, Kentucky, park, leaving one dead
headlines.description: Five people were shot, one fatally, during summer festivities at a downtown Lexington, Kentucky, park on Saturday evening, according to police.

headlines.title: A year after 3-year-old’s drowning, influencer apologizes for letting 16-month-old skip life jacket
headlines.description: An influencer whose 3-year-old son drowned more than a year ago has apologized for letting her 16-month-old sit on a boat without a life jacket, telling followers it was a lapse in judgment she deeply regrets.

headlines.title: Witness video of Madison police killing raises questions of why lethal force was used
headlines.description: Local authorities said that the matter is being investigated and that the officers involved have been placed on administrative leave.

headlines.title: Rep. Ro Khanna calls for ‘Data Center Bill of Rights’ and says the industry needs regulation
headlines.description: Rep. Ro Khanna called for a “Data Center Bill of Rights,” arguing that data centers needed to be regulated so local communities have a larger say on where to build them.

headlines.title: Novak Djokovic reveals unspecified health issue following ouster at the Cincinnati Open
headlines.description: Tennis star Novak Djokovic alluded to a health condition after an early exit from the Cincinnati Open on Saturday, in which he lost to 25-year-old Thiago Agustín Tirante in the second round.

headlines.title: Five shot in Lexington, Kentucky, park, leaving one dead
headlines.description: Five people were shot, one fatally, during summer festivities at a downtown Lexington, Kentucky, park on Saturday evening, according to police.

headlines.title: Attorney General Todd Blanche says the DOJ may take states’ voter roll fight to Supreme Court
headlines.description: Todd Blanche said there’s a “possibility” that the Justice Department will ask the Supreme Court to rule on cases where the federal government’s is attempting to gain access to state voter rolls ahead of November’s midterm elections.

headlines.title: Man charged with operating boat under the influence in crash that killed 2 kids
headlines.description: A New Jersey man surrendered to authorities Friday on charges that he was operating a boat under the influence in connection with a July incident where two children, ages 7 and 9, were thrown into the water and died, police said.

headlines.title: 13-year-old survivor of Michigan rampage called 911 to report she’d been shot
headlines.description: A 13-year-old girl — the only survivor of a shooting rampage in rural Michigan — called 911 on Friday after she was shot four times, state police official and her family said Saturday.

headlines.title: Democrats set their 2028 primary calendar, with South Carolina going first
headlines.description: AUSTIN, Texas — Democrats teed up South Carolina to lead a six-state gantlet of early presidential contests, sealing a 2028 road map that pushes Black and Latino voters and labor to the front of the line for choosing the party’s next national leader.
